title: Shin Megami Tensei (Super Famicom, English translation patch)

source.note: rom/shin-megami-tensei.sfc is the owner's Japanese Super Famicom dump with the owner's two English translation IPS patches applied in order (2026-11-17): smte1 = the translation (made for a ROM with the 512-byte copier header), smte2 = its bug-fix patch (made for a ROM without). Rebuild: python3 games/shin-megami-tensei/tools/mkrom.py. The patched ROM's internal checksum is not updated by the patches (header_checksum_ok false is expected). Nothing of this is committed.
